disclaimer: Educational decision support only. Similar symptoms can have non-disease causes. Confirm diagnosis with a KVK, agricultural extension officer, or plant pathologist. Use only products registered for the crop and disease locally and follow the current label.

symptoms: White growth appears beneath leaves; tubers develop firm brown rot
prevention: Use certified seed and destroy cull piles
Use resistant varieties and monitor blight forecasts
treatment: Act urgently and remove small infected patches safely
Use a registered anti-oomycete program under expert advice
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Older leaves develop target-like brown rings

prevention: Rotate crops and use clean seed

treatment: Use a registered fungicide only after confirming disease pressure
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit

symptoms: Hard black bodies adhere to tuber skin
Sprouts and stems develop brown cankers, causing uneven emergence
prevention: Plant certified clean seed in warm well-drained soil
Rotate crops and harvest promptly after skin set
treatment: No treatment removes existing tuber scurf
Use locally approved seed treatment and sanitation next season
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit

symptoms: Raised, corky, or pitted lesions form on tubers
prevention: Use resistant varieties and clean seed

treatment: No curative treatment exists after lesions form
Adjust soil and rotation practices after testing soil pH

treatment: Remove affected plants under local guidance and report suspected regulated outbreaks

symptoms: Stem bases become black, soft, and slimy
Tubers develop wet soft foul-smelling decay
prevention: Use certified seed and sanitize cutting equipment
Avoid planting or harvesting in wet soil and prevent tuber injury
treatment: Remove affected plants and rotting tubers
Dry harvested tubers and improve cool ventilated storage
